主要内容: On February 15, 2017, Taxi Medallion Loan Trust III, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into an amendment to the Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement dated December 12, 2016. The amendment implemented technical changes to improve the Trust’s flexibility under the credit facility. The Trust is a separate legal and corporate entity with its own creditors, and its assets are not available to pay obligations of its affiliates or any other party. The amendment is attached as Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated by reference into the filing. This change may affect the Trust’s operational flexibility and its financial structure within the broader financial services industry.
